steps: Whisk the miso paste, mirin, sake and soy sauce into a marinade and coat the salmon fillet. Leave it 20 minutes, or overnight if you have it.
Cook the white rice according to package directions.
Slice the cucumber thinly, salt it, squeeze out the water and dress it with the rice vinegar - this is the tsukemono for the pickle slot of the box.
Wipe the excess marinade off the salmon and grill or pan-sear it 4 minutes per side, watching it closely because the miso catches quickly.
Steam the broccoli 4 minutes until tender-crisp, and boil the edamame 3 minutes and drain.
Pack the rice, salmon, broccoli, edamame and cucumber pickle into a bento box.

note: Miso in the glaze made this misoyaki, not teriyaki - teriyaki is soy, sake, mirin and sugar with no miso. Took the report's route (b): kept the miso, renamed the dish honestly, and added the mirin and sake the marinade actually needs (both Phase A registry rows). Honey dropped. Added a cucumber sunomono for the tsukemono slot, since a bento's 4:3:2:1 ratio wants a pickle and this box had none. White Pepper dropped - it belongs to neither preparation. Macro-neutral, +4%.

steps: Cook the white rice, then fold through the rice vinegar, sugar and salt while it is still warm to make shari. Let it cool to room temperature.
Beat the egg, cook it as a thin sheet in a non-stick pan, and slice it into long strips.
Julienne the cucumber and carrot.
Lay a sheet of nori on a rolling mat and spread the seasoned rice over it, leaving a bare strip along the far edge.
Line up the cucumber, carrot and egg strips across the rice, then roll tightly and seal the bare edge with a little water.
Cut the roll into 8 pieces and serve with the soy sauce.

note: A whole-wheat tortilla wrapped around sushi rice is a sushi burrito, a 2010s San Francisco invention - norimaki is literally 'nori roll', so swapping out the nori removed the thing that makes it sushi. Took the report's route (a) and made it real maki: tortilla and avocado out, Nori (a Phase A row) and a tamago egg sheet in. Fixed the phantom rice vinegar that step 1 had always named without it being an ingredient, and added the sugar that sushi-zu needs. servingSize '8 pieces' now matches the steps, which previously said to slice it in half. About -19% calories with a large fat drop; it was already a light entry, so worth watching in the validator.

steps: Cook the brown rice according to package directions.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Mince the garlic and grate the ginger.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and cook the chicken until golden on all sides, about 6-8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the broccoli florets, sliced carrot, green beans and edamame and stir-fry 4-5 minutes.
Splash in the soy sauce and toss, then take the wok off the heat and stir the sesame oil through at the end.
Season with salt and white pepper and serve over the rice.

note: Relabeled American rather than the report's Chinese: the report says brown rice plus the broccoli/green-bean/edamame set is the Western health-bowl composition and that keeping the brown rice makes the honest label American. Same treatment as its sibling Turkey Stir Fry, so the two stay consistent. Renamed off the bare technique name. Added the aromatics whose absence marked it as generic, and fixed the technique: it now fries in Vegetable Oil and finishes with the sesame oil off the heat, since toasted sesame oil is a finishing oil that turns bitter over a hot wok.

steps: Simmer the shiitake mushroom, the smashed garlic and the sliced ginger in about 2 cups of water for 20 minutes to build the broth, then lift out the mushroom and slice it.
Poach the chicken breast in the broth until cooked through, about 12 minutes, then lift it out and slice it.
Soft-boil the egg 6-7 minutes, peel it and halve it.
Mix the soy sauce and mirin into a shoyu tare and stir it into the broth. Season with salt and white pepper.
Cook the ramen noodles in a separate pot of boiling water, about 3 minutes, and drain them well - never cook noodles in the broth or it goes cloudy and starchy.
Wilt the spinach in the hot broth for a minute.
Put the noodles in a bowl, ladle the broth over, and top with the sliced chicken, the egg, the spinach, the sliced shiitake and the green onion. Finish with the sesame oil.

note: The old dish existed in no tradition: rice noodles in a soy-seasoned broth with a soft egg borrows the ramen idiom, but ramen is never a rice noodle, while pho has no egg and no soy. The report's first choice was to rebuild it as Pho Ga - I did NOT do that, because slice 12 keeps Chicken Pho and the app would have ended up with two chicken phos. Took the report's stated alternative instead, which Phase A unblocked by adding Ramen Noodles: a real shoyu chicken ramen, with an actual aromatic broth instead of water plus soy. Ingredient overlap with Miso Ramen is 50%, under the near-duplicate threshold - shoyu tare and miso tare are genuinely different bowls. Also removes the phantom 'dashi broth' the old step named without it being an ingredient. +24% calories.

steps: Cook the white rice according to package directions.
Slice the turkey breast into thin strips. Mince the garlic and grate the ginger.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the turkey strips and stir-fry 3-4 minutes until browned.
Add the sliced bell pepper and broccoli florets and stir-fry 3 more minutes.
Splash in the soy sauce and toss, then take the wok off the heat and stir the sesame oil through. Season with salt and white pepper.
Serve over the rice.

note: Took the report's recommended route (a). Turkey is essentially absent from Japanese and Chinese cooking, so a Japanese label was indefensible; relabeled American and renamed off the bare technique name. No protein change, which deliberately keeps Turkey Breast at 5 recipe references and off the below-5 watchlist. Only the technique changed: sears in Vegetable Oil, finishes with the sesame oil off the heat. The garlic-and-ginger-first handling was already correct and was left alone.
